prompt:
A small company starts with an initial capital of $10,000.

In its first year, the company experiences a 20% loss on its initial capital.

In its second year, it makes a 25% profit on the capital it had at the *end* of the first year.

At the end of the second year, the company decides to invest 40% of its current capital into new equipment.

Finally, of the remaining capital, 30% is distributed as bonuses to employees.

What is the exact numerical value of the capital left after the bonuses are distributed?
